excerpt: Table 1 reports total GPU times of 6.3 seconds for US airlines, 4.1 seconds for US migrations, 7.4 seconds for Radial, 29.2 seconds for France air, and 5.2 seconds for Poker. Table 2 reports CUDA timings of 2 ms for inflation, 8 ms for holes, 2 ms for skeletonization, less than 12 ms for paths, and 3 ms for attraction.
overview: The table values ground the performance claim in reported measurements rather than only complexity arguments. They show seconds-scale complete runs on several graph datasets and millisecond-scale GPU primitives, though the results are tied to the authors' hardware, image size, and implementation choices.
title: CUDA Performance Measurements
